newsitem.title: UK: Boots unit buys Italian skin care business.
newsitem.headline: Boots unit buys Italian skin care business.

text.p: Pharmaceuticals and personal products conglomerate Boots Company Plc said on Thursday its subsidiary Boots Healthcare International has acquired a private Italian skin care business for 4.1 million stg.
Boots said the business, Farmila Dermical, has an annual turnover of two million stg and is strong in therapeutic areas of psoriasis, seborrhoeic dermatitis and dry skin.
Some of its brands include Balta, Riaderm and Leviax.
"The addition of Farmila Dermical will take total annual sales for BH Italy to more than 15 million stg," Boots said in the statement.
